mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_event_log (id, task_id, step_id, event_type, event_message, event_payload, operator_type, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{stepId}, #{eventType}, #{eventMessage}, CAST(#{eventPayload, typeHandler=com.aiexplorer.researchagent.infrastructure.persistence.store.mybatis.JsonNodeTypeHandler} AS JSON), #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, step_id, event_type, event_message, event_payload, operator_type, operator_id, created_at FROM task_event_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
